business_summary.text: Diffusion Engineers Limited specializes in wear protection and engineering solutions for industrial sectors including cement, steel, power, and mining. The company manufactures welding consumables, wear plates, wear parts, and heavy engineering equipment, with a focus on improving asset life and operational efficiency for customers.

call_points.text: Management expects 20% revenue growth and 100-200 bps EBITDA margin improvement in FY27
New capacity expansion (₹100 Cr) has started phased commissioning, expected to contribute from next quarter
EBITDA margin moderated to 12.85% due to higher raw material costs; expects recovery as prices stabilize
₹67 Cr of IPO proceeds still unutilized, expected to be fully utilized by year-end
Defense revenue contributes 1.5-2% of total revenue; progress on VSHORADS prototype through Tejorup
Raw material volatility (tungsten, nickel, cobalt) is managed through small validity periods and immediate procurement
